measurement.qualification: Wall ends at the independent wait-thread terminal receipt and includes command startup, all awaited phases and final result writing. GNU RSS is a process high-water statistic, not simultaneous tree memory. Summed RSS double-counts shared pages; sampled summed PSS apportions them and can miss transient peaks. OS page cache is uncontrolled; no cache flush or cold-storage claim. Observer CPU is separate and observation overhead is not calibrated away.

qualification: Failure within registered200route iterations; not mathematical unroutability or a legal CPD/resource point. Initial graph-index construction and failed routing remain in measured command cost.
